include { BCFTOOLS_MPILEUP } from 'nf-core/bcftools/mpileup'
include { NGSCHECKMATE_NCM } from 'nf-core/ngscheckmate/ncm'
// please note this subworkflow requires the options for bcltools_mpileup that are included in the nextflow.config
workflow BAM_NGSCHECKMATE {

    take:
    ch_input            // channel: [ val(meta1), bam/cram ]
    ch_snp_bed          // channel: [ val(meta2), bed ]
    ch_fasta            // channel: [ val(meta3), fasta, fai ]

    main:
    ch_input_bed = ch_input
        .combine(ch_snp_bed)
        .map{ input_meta, input_file, _bed_meta, bed_file ->
            [input_meta, input_file, bed_file, []]
        }

    BCFTOOLS_MPILEUP (ch_input_bed, ch_fasta.collect(), false)

    BCFTOOLS_MPILEUP
    .out
    .vcf
    .map{_meta, vcf -> vcf}    // discard individual metas
    .collect()                // group into one channel
    .map{files -> [files]}    // make the channel into [vcf1, vcf2, ...]
    .set {ch_collected_vcfs}

    ch_snp_bed
    .map{meta, _bed -> meta} // use the snp_bed file meta as the meta for the merged channel
    .combine(ch_collected_vcfs) // add the vcf files after the meta, now looks like [meta, [vcf1, vcf2, ... ] ]
    .set {ch_vcfs}

    NGSCHECKMATE_NCM (ch_vcfs, ch_snp_bed, ch_fasta)

    emit:
    corr_matrix  = NGSCHECKMATE_NCM.out.corr_matrix  // channel: [ meta, corr_matrix ]
    matched      = NGSCHECKMATE_NCM.out.matched      // channel: [ meta, matched ]
    all          = NGSCHECKMATE_NCM.out.all          // channel: [ meta, all ]
    vcf          = BCFTOOLS_MPILEUP.out.vcf          // channel: [ meta, vcf ]
    pdf          = NGSCHECKMATE_NCM.out.pdf          // channel: [ meta, pdf ]

}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_ngscheckmate"
description: "Take a set of bam files and run NGSCheckMate to determine whether samples\
  \ match with each other, using a set of SNPs."
keywords:
- "ngscheckmate"
- "qc"
- "bam"
- "snp"
components:
- "bcftools/mpileup"
- "ngscheckmate/ncm"
input:
- ch_input:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM file for each sample.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta1), path(bam)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
- ch_snp_bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "BED file containing the SNPs to analyse. NGSCheckMate provides some\
      \ default ones for hg19/hg38.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(snp_bed) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bed"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Fasta file for the genome and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta3),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
output:
- corr_matrix:
    type: "file"
    description: "A text file containing the correlation matrix between each sample.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(corr_matrix) ]\n"
    pattern: "*corr_matrix.txt"
- matched:
    type: "file"
    description: "A txt file containing only the samples that match with each other.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(matched) ]\n"
    pattern: "*matched.txt"
- all:
    type: "file"
    description: "A txt file containing all the sample comparisons, whether they match\
      \ or not.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(all) ]\n"
    pattern: "*all.txt"
- vcf:
    type: "file"
    description: "vcf file for each sample giving the SNP calls.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(vcf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
- pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "A pdf containing a dendrogram showing how the samples match up.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pdf"
authors:
- "@SPPearce"
maintainers:
- "@SPPearce"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bcftools/mpileup@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/ngscheckmate/ncm@0.0.0-df69bf6"
